slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: theme_label
slots.about: the swatch row's label; the picked swatch's name shows under it

slots.name: themes
slots.about: swatches, copied into state: id (1 up, in order), name, fill and ink (colour role names, never a colour value); 0 or more

slots.name: default_theme
slots.about: the id of the swatch picked at first and after reset

slots.name: swatch_glyph
slots.about: the short sample text on each swatch that is not picked (a check takes its place on the picked one)

slots.name: choices
slots.about: picker rows, copied into state: id, label, options (words unique across every row: a pick finds its row by its words), default and now (both one of options)

slots.name: switches
slots.about: switch rows, copied into state: id, name, line (one line under the name), help (a longer note, blank for none), default and on (both true or false)

slots.name: on_word
slots.about: spoken after a switch row's name when it is on

slots.name: off_word
slots.about: spoken after a switch row's name when it is off

slots.name: help_label
slots.about: the small link under a switch that has help; a tap opens the note in place, a second tap closes it

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: shown when there is nothing to set

slots.name: pick_theme
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: picks a swatch

slots.name: choose
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the word picked in a picker row

slots.name: flip
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: turns a switch row on or off

slots.name: toggle_help
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens or closes one row's help note

slots.name: reset
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: puts every setting back to its default; shows only when something differs; the label is the button's words

empty.shows: empty_note only; each block also hides on its own when its list is empty

fallback.shows: one help note open in place under its row, its link icon turned to a chevron

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, smooth, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the picked swatch carries a check and its name shows under the label; a switch's knob moves side to side and its state is spoken
